description: This file defines data structures and parsing logic for handling deep links, including URL parsing, decoding, and route mapping. It includes enumerations, structs, and parsing functions related to 'DeepLinkRoute', 'GatewayConnectDeepLink', and 'AgentDeepLink'.

classes.name: GatewayConnectDeepLink
classes.description: Represents connection details for a gateway, including host, port, TLS flag, and optional authentication tokens, with methods for parsing setup codes and generating URLs.

classes.name: AgentDeepLink
classes.description: Represents an agent message link with associated parameters like message content, session key, and delivery options.

methods.name: fromSetupCode
methods.description: Parses a base64url-encoded JSON setup code into a GatewayConnectDeepLink object, extracting URL components and configuration options.

methods.name: decodeBase64Url
methods.description: Decodes a base64url-encoded string into Data, handling URL-safe characters and padding.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a URL with 'openclaw' scheme into a DeepLinkRoute, routing to agent or gateway based on URL host and query parameters.
